text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I make my way to the track a little early
for
morning training. As soon as I arrive...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, looks like I'm first again! Ah, it
sure feels
good to be number one in
everything! ♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Okay, time to get changed! I'm going to
run my
heart out today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet seems to be in a very
good mood
as she prepares to train.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You... you were here before me?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No! I thought I was the first one to
arrive! I can't
believe I'm second!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No! I thought I was the first one to
arrive! I can't
believe I'm second!
choice_data_list: いつもこんなに早いのか？
いつもこんなに早いの？
choice_data_list_en: Second place is still plenty impressive.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I suppose you could call me a
morning
person. Although it seems you
got the better of
me today.
choice_data_list: いつもこんなに早いのか？
いつもこんなに早いの？
choice_data_list_en: Second place is still plenty impressive.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The morning is when I can concentrate
the best. I
can run freely without
worrying about others
watching me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm always aiming to be number one. I
want to be
the first to arrive at school
and the runner who
completes the most
laps.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's not the same! Being second place is
out of the
question! It's first or nothing!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Getting here early just doesn't hit the
same way if
I'm not number one! Ugh, I'm
so, so, so ANGRY!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You won't be so lucky tomorrow! I'm
gonna be
first to school for sure!
